findings.title: Unauthenticated one-request DoS: /api/batch and /api/zip take an unbounded list of item names with no de-duplication
findings.evidence: `const names = body.items.map(validName)` / `for (const n of names) if (!existsSync(join(dir, n))) ...` with body `items: t.Array(t.String())` (no maxItems; `items()` caps at 2000 for delete/copy/move but not here). Guests hold `batchdownload` by default. A visitor gets a CSRF token from GET /api/session, then POSTs /api/batch with space=public and one existing public name repeated ~1.7M times (17 MB body): ~1.7M synchronous existsSync calls block the event loop, and the array stays in `batches` for 5 minutes; GET /api/batch/<token> walks the folder once per repetition. Same missing cap in POST /api/zip (line 259).

findings.title: POST /api/password checks the current password with no lockout, so a stolen session can brute-force it and then pass the step-up
findings.evidence: `if (!(await Bun.password.verify(body.current, u.passwordHash))) throw new HttpError(400, 'auth.wrong-current-password')` with no lockedFor/recordFailure, unlike confirmPassword. With a session cookie + CSRF token an attacker can send unlimited guesses; the password then unlocks update install, restore and 2FA changes.

findings.title: Login lockout is keyed only by ip|username: no per-account or per-IP limit, so distributed guessing, spraying and audit-log flooding are never throttled
findings.evidence: `const key = `${ip}|${username.toLowerCase()}`` then lockedFor/recordFailure. A different username per request never locks; each attempt costs an argon2 verify and a synchronous audit append. An account guessed from many IPs is never locked as a whole. Same for /login/2fa and share unlock.

findings.title: Upload-request links bypass the visitors' daily allowance and have no default size cap, so any holder of the link can fill the disk down to the reserve
findings.evidence: initUpload is called without `guest`, so reserveGuest is skipped; limitOf() returns null when the owner sets no limits; an admin owner or a link in the public space has no quota. A link holder can upload up to uploadMaxSize (10 GB) per file repeatedly until MIN_FREE_SPACE; abandoned announcements hold the 5 per-link slots for UPLOAD_STALE_HOURS.

findings.title: Update packages need no signature unless UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY is set; an admin session plus password can then run arbitrary code as the app user
findings.evidence: `if (!signatureRequired()) return { signed, signatureVerified: false }`. Without a key only self-listed hashes are checked; /api/admin/update/upload → /stage → /apply with the admin password runs the package's server.js in smokeTest (Bun.spawn) and installs it. The admin account is a code-execution account unless the signing key is configured.
